name: Guinan, Ancient Advisor
oracle_text: {1}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that entered this turn. If you put two or more +1/+1 counters on creatures this way, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: {1}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that entered this turn. If you put two or more +1/+1 counters on creatures this way, draw a card.

needs.what: an `as` binding on `add_counters` recording the total number of counters it actually placed (after replacement effects such as Hardened Scales or Doubling Season, and excluding creatures that can't have counters), readable as `{"binding": <as>}` in a following `if` condition (`cmp` >= 2)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters takes only amount/counter/objects/player and writes no binding. Counting the matching creatures (`count` with entered_this_turn) is an approximation: one creature under Hardened Scales gets two counters and should draw, and creatures under cant_have_counters get none and should not count. `counters_put_this_turn` is the whole turn's ledger, and there is no op that binds a scalar value beforehand to subtract it (snapshot captures objects, not values).
